author: piztanza
description: Implement the AI catalog showcase animation loop (F-005) in the AiCatalogCard section: phased ~15s loop (pop-in with name chips → orbit + self-spin → bloom to grid → snap assemble + centered pill → fade/restart), AI status chip flip, IntersectionObserver gating, reduced-motion static assembled state, live bilingual text.
acceptance_criteria: The ~15s loop matches the design: sprites pop in one-by-one with spring ease + name chips, chips fade, sprites glide onto a shrinking orbit (r0 0.36 → r1 0.12 ~1.3s) with self-spin via rAF, bloom to grid with rotate(360), snap assemble with the centered '✓ One catalog · 120M+ mappings' pill, fade out and restart
AI status chip flips reading… → assembled ✓ at the assemble phase in the active language
Loop runs only while the card is in view (IntersectionObserver); all timers/rAF cancelled on stop/unmount
prefers-reduced-motion (or static prop) shows the assembled static state with pill + done chip
Language toggle updates chips, pill, and status text live, including mid-loop
Suite stays green; unit tests cover the phase scheduler timings and en/id key completeness for scn1-6, cat_pill, cat_ai_read, cat_ai_done
